title: I built a free XAUUSD planning and discipline hub — looking for honest feedback
author: Loose-Object-8913
selftext:
I trade and develop tools around XAUUSD, and I wanted one place I could genuinely use before and after each session.

It currently includes:

* Daily gold plan with support, resistance and invalidation
* USD economic calendar with impact and possible gold reactions
* London and New York session clocks
* Risk and position-size calculator
* Pre-trade checklist
* Private post-trade journal and discipline statistics

It doesn’t provide signals, promise returns or upload anyone’s journal. Personal data stays inside your browser, and the tools are completely free.

I built it for my own process, but I’d appreciate honest feedback from other traders—especially anything confusing, unnecessary or missing.

[https://omegatradinghq.com/hub](https://omegatradinghq.com/hub)
